purpose: Inventory and classify all pre-Collector governance, universe, reconciliation, comparable, forecast, ranking, package, and handoff artifacts; identify the last authentic pre-Collector control point; and distinguish reusable architecture from invalid cross-lane output without modifying source authorities or executing forecasts.
mandatory_checks: Verify the owner-approved pre-Collector scope authority exists and declares the precollector_booster_boxes lane.
Verify Collector Booster boxes are prohibited as pre-Collector target products.
Inventory every tracked path containing precollector or pre-collector semantics.
Record the introducing commit for every inventoried path.
Flag any path introduced in the quarantined commit range.
Flag any pre-Collector contract or implementation that binds a target authority containing collector_v1 or secret_lair.
Identify candidate-universe, reconciliation, comparable, winner, uncertainty, route, forecast, ranking, and purchase-stage artifacts separately.
Do not infer owner approval from test success, package hashes, or downstream inheritance.
Do not execute forecasting, ranking, purchase analysis, Secret Lair work, or combined MTG integration.
change_control: Changes require owner approval, version change, targeted governance tests, full regression, and recertification.
